text:
maria: heads up, hit a weird edge in the SDK while testing the json-mode function call in the onboarding sample app.

kevin: summary?

maria: when the server responds with 429/backpressure, our retry wrapper re-sends the payload but it stringifies the already-serialized `json` body. result: the model returns a `function_call` whose `arguments` field is a JSON string (double-encoded) -> our schema validator fails to parse.

eli: oh no. streaming or non-streaming?

maria: non-streaming with sdk-js, but saw similar in node streaming tests — validator trips mid-stream because we attempt to validate partial chunks.

sam: repro steps?

maria: 1) enable `jsonMode: true` and `fnCall: { name: 'create_ticket' }` in samplekit. 2) trigger rate-limit by setting a tiny rate limit in integration test. 3) inspect the outgoing retry payload in network logs — `body` becomes `"{\"issue\": \"urgent\"}"` instead of `{ "issue": "urgent" }`. 4) model returns function_call with `arguments: "{...}"` -> zod/jsonschema parse error.

kevin: thanks. sounds like our retry wrapper is doing `JSON.stringify(body)` unconditionally. we should only stringify for non-jsonMode paths.

eli: also need to fix schema validator to validate on completed object for streams. validating per-chunk will always fail for nested objects.

maria: proposed quick fix: (a) make retry wrapper preserve original body type (don't stringify if already a string flagged as json-mode), (b) add content-type header `application/json+fncall` or a flag so SDK can detect pre-serialized payloads, (c) change streaming validator to buffer until `done` or until a full JSON parse succeeds.

kevin: agree. i'll own the retry change. assigning to @kevin. sam can you add a unit test that simulates 429 and checks the outgoing payload type?

sam: on it. will add test + small harness for streaming validator behavior.

devx-bot: deploy-checklist: add changelog entry, add compatibility note for users rolling custom retry wrappers.

maria: one more thing — the onboarding sample app should log a clearer error when fncall args are stringified so users don't think model output is invalid. small UX win.

kevin: plan: patch retry by EOD, tests tomorrow, rolling release to beta channel.

eli: thanks, team. can we do a quick RFC doc link? put design notes in /docs/devx/fncall-retries.md and ping me.

maria: will draft that after the patch. :thumbsup:

kevin: +1

sam: +1

maria: marking this thread closed once PR is up.
